CLIP: episode 49, 1 segment(s), 30s
[01:34.40-01:37.80] CATHERINE (Haughty, Imperious): "I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future."
[01:38.00-01:43.80] CAMERA: Full two-shot of Catherine and Father Thomas facing off across the small table in the cavernous hallway.
[01:38.20-01:42.50] ACTION: Father Thomas clasps his hands behind his back, turning slightly away to ponder the gravity of her words.
[01:38.30-01:43.20] CATHERINE (Bitterly Resolute): "Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?"
[01:43.80-01:53.00] CAMERA: Medium shot on Father Thomas turning back around to face her, his countenance etched with genuine concern.
[01:44.20-01:52.80] FATHER THOMAS (Wary, Grave): "If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?"
[01:53.00-01:58.00] CAMERA: Medium two-shot tracking closer as Catherine steps closer toward him.
[01:53.20-01:57.80] CATHERINE (Seductive, Reassuring): "Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful."
[01:58.00-02:04.75] CAMERA: Tight close-up on Father Thomas's intense, brooding face.
[01:58.20-02:04.50] FATHER THOMAS (Stern, Stark): "Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored."
